WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.business_date) AS days_with_activity
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl_net, COUNT(*) AS ctl_days, SUM(CASE WHEN net_sales<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ctl_active_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.store_id, m.net_sales, c.ctl_net, ROUND(m.net_sales-c.ctl_net,2) AS diff, m.days_with_activity, c.ctl_days, c.ctl_active_days
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c USING(store_id) ORDER BY store_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS distinct_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids, MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date), SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s999, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zz, SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web, SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg

SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-15' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id IN (125,129) GROUP BY 1

WITH net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
sales AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1
),
trading AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store cs
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=2 AND is_trading_day) d
  WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id<900
    AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date<=d.calendar_date)
    AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date>=d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id=cs.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales/t.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name,
       ROUND(s.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days, ROUND(s.net_sales/t.trading_days,2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM sales s JOIN trading t USING(store_id) JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank
